Print a topic model summary

Source: R/evaluate.R
print.summary.sbert_topic_model.Rd

print() shows the overview of a topic model summary (documents, segments, topics, model, between-topic share of the variance, mean coherence, topic diversity, and a note when k-means did not converge) followed by the table of topics.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary.sbert_topic_model'
print(x, digits = 4L, ...)

Arguments

x

A summary returned by summary().

digits

Significant digits in the table of topics (default 4).

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

summary.sbert_topic_model().

Examples

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
topic_model <- topics(corpus, n_topics = 6, column = "translation",
                      embeddings = feedback_embeddings)
print(summary(topic_model), digits = 2)
